rules.text: No external UI libraries such as Material UI or Chakra
Only components in the Acme inventory may be used
No hard-coded hex or palette colors in component classes
Only props and variants declared by the component
Compound parts must render inside their parent component
Do not edit base component source files
Do not nest a dialog inside another dialog
Body text must not be smaller than 14px

a11y: Every form control needs a visible label
